name: meowterialyou-widgets
description: MeowterialYou Desktop Widgets GNOME Shell Extension

scripts.copy-assets: cp metadata.json dist/ && cp -r schemas dist/ && mkdir -p dist/styles && cp src/styles/stylesheet.css dist/styles/
scripts.install-extension: npm run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/meowterialyou-widgets@meowterialyou && cp -r dist/* ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/meowterialyou-widgets@meowterialyou/
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../meowterialyou-widgets@meowterialyou.zip .
